scope: Legal analogy, fact/reasoning/element retrieval and evaluation for JEP harm/repair
review_status: Targeted systematic scoping lane; not an exhaustive fieldwide absence proof
reading_policy: Primary full text selectively read for methods, data, evaluation and limitations; no independent reproduction; bibliographic-only items excluded from deep evidence

papers.title: Learning Interpretable Legal Case Retrieval via Knowledge-Guided Case Reformulation
papers.data_and_label_authority: Chinese LeCaRD/LeCaRDv2; case-level expert relevance and charges, heuristic sub-fact supervision
papers.method: Legal-knowledge-guided LLM sub-facts; normalized embeddings; MaxSim/Sum; case and sub-fact contrastive losses.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors report benchmark improvements. Annotated candidate pools, external knowledge and LLM reformulation costs limit transfer; charge-derived sub-fact labels can be noisy.
papers.JEP_implication: Closest counterexample to novelty of typed harm cards or sub-fact matching; JEP must establish victim-centered harm labels and extraction fidelity.

papers.title: An Element is Worth a Thousand Words: Enhancing Legal Case Retrieval by Incorporating Legal Elements
papers.data_and_label_authority: Chinese criminal LeCaRD-Elem; judicial text clusters named/validated by legal experts
papers.method: Extract legal elements, explicitly predict them or internalize teacher representations in a student encoder.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors report improvements; standardized judicial language and annotated elements support training, while annotations restrict transfer.
papers.JEP_implication: Element conditioning/internalization precedes JEP; testimony-specific harm mechanisms and contested facts need independent labels.

papers.title: Logic Rules as Explanations for Legal Case Retrieval
papers.support_locations: Method sections; experimental setup; explanation evaluation
papers.data_and_label_authority: Chinese LeCaRD/ELAM; relevance labels, BM25-derived predicate supervision; small human and LLM explanation evaluations
papers.method: Fuzzy first-order law predicates, sentence-alignment case rules and weighted reciprocal-rank fusion.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors report relevance/explanation gains; rule-shaped transparency does not independently establish factual truth or causal explanation faithfulness.
papers.JEP_implication: Audit source entailment, testimony attribution and missing evidence; explicit logic alone is not a new contribution.

papers.title: Enhancing Legal Case Retrieval via Scaling High-quality Synthetic Query-Candidate Pairs
papers.data_and_label_authority: Chinese judgments; LLM short queries; positive augmentation using charges/articles/prison terms
papers.method: Large synthetic short-query/long-case contrastive training with key-fact extraction and anonymization.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors report benchmark gains; China-only evaluation and legally defined positive heuristics do not validate victim-centered harm equivalence.
papers.JEP_implication: Synthetic scale is established; JEP contribution requires invariant validity, hard semantic counterexamples and human-held-out transfer.

papers.title: CLERC: A Dataset for U.S. Legal Case Retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Analysis Generation
papers.data_and_label_authority: English historical US federal opinions from CAP; removed citations supply relevance
papers.method: Citation-context retrieval with document/chunk candidates and retrieval-augmented legal analysis.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors document retrieval/generation challenges; citation agreement need not mean sound analysis; OCR and historical biases remain.
papers.JEP_implication: Citation recovery cannot substitute for harm relevance or restorative adequacy; evaluate supported spans and expert usefulness separately.

papers.title: Case-based Statute Retrieval for Multi-turn Legal Consultation with Fact-level and Rationale-level Mixed Evidence Graphs
papers.data_and_label_authority: Chinese LexRAG; LeCaRDv2/ClaimGen-CN case evidence; LLM-assisted links; dialogue-grouped selection
papers.method: Fact/rationale case evidence graphs fused with full-corpus dense statute retrieval.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors report improvements; no large-scale human validation of accepted graph links; coverage and single-language benchmark limits. Generation only diagnostic.
papers.JEP_implication: Reason/fact bridges are prior art; JEP needs source-faithful graphs and raw retrieval fallback under missing coverage.

papers.title: SAGA: Structured Applicability-Guided Alignment for Conversational Legal Retrieval
papers.data_and_label_authority: Chinese LexRAG and STARD; statute-retrieval relevance
papers.method: Training-free raw/structured dense fusion; case frames include missing facts; statute frames encode prerequisites/effects.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors report stronger gains on multi-turn LexRAG than STARD. Extraction omissions and fine applicability remain unresolved; fusion tuned on development data.
papers.JEP_implication: Missing-fact frames already exist; JEP novelty must preserve unknown/contested testimony and source roles rather than inventing inferred facts.

papers.title: Implicit Hierarchical Modeling for Cross-System Legal Case Retrieval
papers.data_and_label_authority: English COLIEE2025 citation relevance; Chinese ELAM annotated pairs
papers.method: Legal-span representations; residual quantization semantic IDs; hierarchy graph; staged contrastive representation training.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors report gains in two legal systems; latent hierarchy is not expert doctrinal taxonomy. Two benchmarks do not prove general jurisdiction transfer.
papers.JEP_implication: Hierarchical legal geometry is established; test actual alignment to expert harm/repair distinctions and counterexamples.

papers.title: CaseFacts: A Benchmark for Legal Fact-Checking and Precedent Retrieval
papers.support_locations: Dataset annotation; retrieval and fact-checking evaluation
papers.data_and_label_authority: English SCOTUS/Oyez summaries; LLM synthesis/verification and human-quality-annotated test subset
papers.method: Supported/refuted/overruled claims; contrastive claim-case retrieval; evidence and verdict evaluation.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Unrestricted search worsened their measured joint performance through noisy/out-of-corpus evidence; this is benchmark-specific, not a universal web-search result.
papers.JEP_implication: Fact support, harm resemblance and adequacy of repair need separate labels; synthetic quality validation has clear precedent.

papers.title: DELTA: Pre-train a Discriminative Encoder for Legal Case Retrieval via Structural Word Alignment
papers.support_locations: §3 methods; experimental setup/results; inspected March2024 preprint, not final AAAI text
papers.data_and_label_authority: Chinese LeCaRD/CAIL and English COLIEE; judgment fact/reasoning/decision sections
papers.method: Fact encoder bottleneck reconstructs masked reasoning/decision; structural word alignment pulls toward key facts.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Authors report zero-shot/fine-tuned gains; court reasoning and decisions provide supervision that hearings may lack. Final venue DOI 10.1609/AAAI.V39I25.34914.
papers.JEP_implication: Connecting reasoning back into the encoder is not itself novel; source-faithful theory conditioning needs causal controls and no outcome leakage.

papers.title: LeCaRDv2: A Large-Scale Chinese Legal Case Retrieval Dataset
papers.support_locations: Query taxonomy; relevance annotation; candidate pooling
papers.data_and_label_authority: Chinese criminal law; 800 queries/55,192 candidates; multi-expert relevance on characterization/penalty/procedure
papers.method: Diverse query strata and candidate pooling across lexical, dense and article similarity systems.
papers.reported_results_and_limits: Pool construction explicitly addresses lexical-only omissions; benchmark judgments remain pool-dependent. DOI 10.1145/3626772.3657887.
papers.JEP_implication: Diverse hard-negative pools are established; JEP must audit unjudged relevant material and split hearing/episode families.

gaps.claim: Victim-centered conditional harm resemblance and restorative response adequacy require distinct relevance judgments; citation/offense/statute relevance cannot supply them.
gaps.confidence: High task mismatch; moderate novelty confidence because Spanish/domain review incomplete

gaps.claim: Unknown and contested testimony should remain source-traceable, with explicit abstention rather than inferred normative facts.
gaps.confidence: Moderate JEP applicability; missing-fact representation itself already established

gaps.claim: Human-held-out testimony retrieval needs diverse pooled qrels, unjudged audits, family splits and expert-review effort.
gaps.confidence: High evaluation need; benchmark methodology is adaptation, not novel

gaps.claim: Theory-conditioned source-faithful reasoning must demonstrate encoder changes beyond labels, topics or verdict leakage.
gaps.confidence: Potentially useful experiment; not established novel
